title: Story Clue Crew · Q3 W14 D01
objective: Use details from a story to explain characters, events, and ideas.
introduction: Milo is reading about Nina and the bird! 🐱 Use story clues to explain what happened and why. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: the person or animal in the story

activities.instruction: Listen and learn how to find story clues!
activities.content: Nina heard a soft knock on the door. A little bird had flown into the porch. Nina opened the window, and the bird flew out into the sky.

items.explanation: The story is about Nina and the bird. The mailman, the teacher, and the cook are not in the story.
The bird flew into the porch, so that is where the story happens. The market, the beach, and the school are not in the story.

options.text: a little bird flew into the porch and Nina set it free
Nina caught the bird in a cage.
The bird knocked with its beak.

items.explanation: The story says a little bird flew into the porch and Nina set it free. Nina did not catch the bird in a cage, the windows were not closed, and the bird did not knock with its beak.

items.prompt: Which detail is TRUE from the story?

options.text: The bird knocked with its beak.
Nina opened the window so the bird could fly out.
Nina caught the bird in a cage.

items.explanation: The story says Nina opened the window and the bird flew out. The bird did not knock with its beak, Nina did not close the windows, and she did not catch the bird in a cage.

items.prompt: How did Nina feel at the end of the story?
items.explanation: Nina felt glad because the bird flew out free. Angry, sleepy, and hungry do not match the end of the story.
